related_questions.question: What is the best thing to take to reduce COVID symptoms?
related_questions.snippet: Manage Symptoms Most people with COVID-19 have mild illness and can recover at home. You can treat symptoms with over-the-counter medicines, such as acetaminophen or ibuprofen, to help feel better.

related_questions.question: When should you not take turmeric?
related_questions.snippet: People who should not take turmeric include those with gallbladder problems, bleeding disorders, diabetes, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), infertility, iron deficiency, liver disease, hormone-sensitive conditions, and arrhythmia. Pregnant women and those who are going to undergo surgery should not use turmeric.

related_questions.question: What supplements should you take when you have COVID-19?
related_questions.snippet: These include vitamin C, vitamin D, and zinc. Herbal supplements, probiotics, and other dietary supplement ingredients might also affect immunity and inflammation. Eating a variety of nutritious foods can give you enough vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients for a healthy immune system.

related_questions.question: What should you avoid when you have COVID-19?
